title: Static or predictable IV/nonce
message: The IV or nonce is static or predictably generated.
remediation: Generate a fresh IV or nonce with a CSPRNG for every encryption.

title: ECB mode used
remediation: Use an authenticated mode such as GCM.

title: Weak hash
message: A deprecated hash algorithm is used in a security-sensitive context.
remediation: Use SHA-256 or a stronger approved hash for security-sensitive hashing.

title: Insecure randomness for crypto
message: Cryptographic material originates from a non-cryptographic random source.
remediation: Use the platform cryptographic random generator.
